ns2:course.label: Fourth Year Japanese I
ns2:course.description: Further developments of skills in sophisticated Japanese language use, including readings in authentic materials in a wide variety of writing styles, writing for formal occasions, and speaking appropriately according to the situation while using precise vocabulary in correct level of speech. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JAPN 306 or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JAPN 306 or equivalent.
